postconditions.description: The number of characters n is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of known relationships m is between 0 and 100,000.
The function count_ways(n, m) returns the number of ways to fill in the remaining relationships so that you are happy with every triangle modulo 1,000,000,007.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= a_i, b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i, c_i in known_relationships)
invariants.description: Each pair of characters a_i and b_i is between 1 and n, and they are not the same character.

invariants.expression: all(c_i in {0, 1} for a_i, b_i, c_i in known_relationships)
invariants.description: Each relationship c_i is either 0 (hate) or 1 (love).

invariants.expression: all(a_i, b_i, c_i not in known_relationships for a_i, b_i, c_i in all_possible_relationships if (a_i, b_i, c_i) not in known_relationships)
invariants.description: All possible relationships not already known are considered.
